Please note, you must be at least 18 years old to experience the thrill of skydiving at Skydive the Farm. blurb: Skydive the Farm in Rockmart Georgia. A full-time turbine dropzone open 7 days per week. Events and boogies throughout the year with discounted tandem special weekdays. Swooping competitions at Georgia's best swoop pond. 55 acres of private property with separate high-performance and standard landing areas, and plenty of outs. Fully carpeted packing area in the hangar. Less than one hour from Downtown Atlanta.
